notes.content: A typed letter addressed to Murre, with a handwritten date at upper right and an archival 9 at lower left. The first paragraph sends a promised ramification-data sketch and annotated manuscript, says sections 1–5 will be replaced, requests clearer layout and references, and cautions that the phrase about primitive nth roots over S needs clarification. Six proposed topics follow. The bottom paragraph proposes retaining sections 6–10 with changes and adding a section 11 appendix on a tame Lefschetz variant. The final sentence continues beyond this page. All prose, six outline entries, punctuation, and mathematical signs were visually read; the retained doubts are local and documented.
